name: MiniMax-H3 360 Orbit Workflow
description: One photo into a 360 camera orbit workflow

paragraphs: A Gradio Workflow (node-based canvas) that turns one photo into a 360° camera orbit video with the scene held still — with the denoiser inlined into this Space: the orbit operator node is a bound Python function (orbit in orbit.py, adapted from pablodawson/minimax-h3-360-orbit) decorated with @spaces.GPU, so runs execute on this Space's own ZeroGPU hardware, not through a gradio client call to the upstream Space.

The canvas wires a Photo to orbit reference (prefilled with an example) into the orbit function node and out to two subjects: the Orbit Video and the Run Report. The five knobs — canvas, steps, seed, LoRA strength, duration — are literal reference nodes prefilled with the LoRA card's recommendations (768x768, 28 steps, seed 904231, strength 1.0, 3 s ≈ 73 frames).

One remote call remains by design: the 62 GiB Qwen3-VL conditioner half of the split MiniMax-H3 deployment still runs in multimodalart/qwen3vl-conditioner and is called over the gradio API per request — MiniMax-H3's two halves cannot share one Space's storage quota. Everything else (the pruned transformer partition, both VAEs, the orbit LoRA) loads and runs here.

requirements.text: HF OAuth is enabled: sign in on the canvas to run the pipeline; the conditioner call is billed to your identity.
